I've written the chart and rendered it on the fake data, but I haven't looked at the picture yet, so I don't know if it reads well.

The request text came through garbled, because the name-scrubbing mangled the status names. I read it as "what share of visits had each status, by district". The chart is 100% stacked horizontal bars with one bar per district. Each bar splits that district's visits by status, and the segments are labelled with percentages. Statuses are read from the data at run time. Beyond the top 6 they're grouped as "Others".

- **Chart file:** `file-skills/field_visits_messy/charts/status_share_by_district.py`

- **Handback:** I've already written `done.json`, so Idli will pick the chart up. I skipped the "looks right?" card because this session can't take card answers.
- **Skill version:** unchanged at v1, since the existing form already had what the chart needs.

The mock has three common statuses plus a few stray variants, so the "Others" grouping isn't exercised here. Rows with no district (3 in the mock) or no status are left out of the shares. If you wanted the share for one specific status only, say which and I'll change the chart.
